<tr>
    <td>[[File:{{{img|}}}|300px|center]]<center>{{{note|}}}</center></td>
    <td style="font-size: 95%; line-height: 1.4; class="game-font-face">
        {{Characterbox|{{{unit|unknown}}}}}<br>
        <center>
            <div style="font-size: 140%; line-height: 1.4; class="game-font-face">{{{cosmetics|}}}</div>
        </center>
        {{#if: {{{shinyimg|}}} |<div style="font-size: 140%; line-height: 1.4; class="game-font-face">Shiny [[File:{{{img|}}}|300px|center]]</div>| }}
    </td>
    {{#if: {{{buff|}}} |<td style="text-align: center;">{{{buff}}}</td>| }}
</tr>
